```python
# First, ensure fire is installed
fire_install = await run_command("uv pip install fire")
print(fire_install[-200:])

import asyncio
await asyncio.sleep(5)
fire_check = await run_command('python -c "import fire; print(\'ok\')"')
print(fire_check)

# Now re-run the OfficeBench Word read_file tool cleanly
word_result = await run_command("python3 skills/OfficeBench/tools/word/read_file.py --file_path /workspace/testbed/docs/Meeting_Notes_2024_06.docx")
print(repr(word_result))

# Parse out just the paragraph text from the tool output
# The tool prefixes with "OBSERVATION: The following is the content from the word file:\n"
# and the shell appends "\n(.venv) \n" at the end
lines = word_result.split("\n")

# Find the OBSERVATION prefix line and take everything after it, excluding (.venv) trailer
start_idx = None
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if "OBSERVATION" in line and "content from the word file" in line:
        start_idx = i + 1
        break

if start_idx is not None:
    # Collect lines after the OBSERVATION header, excluding trailing (.venv)
    content_lines = []
    for line in lines[start_idx:]:
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped == "(.venv)" or stripped == "":
            continue
        content_lines.append(line)
    paragraph_text = "\n".join(content_lines)
else:
    # Fallback: just strip (.venv) trailer
    paragraph_text = word_result.strip()
    if paragraph_text.endswith("(.venv)"):
        paragraph_text = paragraph_text[:-len("(.venv)")].strip()

print(f"Extracted paragraph text:\n{repr(paragraph_text)}")

# Save the clean paragraph text
await write_file("./output/Meeting_Notes_2024_06.txt", paragraph_text)
print("File saved.")

# Final verification - read back and confirm
final_check = await read_file("./output/Meeting_Notes_2024_06.txt")
print(final_check)
```
